input_dataset.provenance: Clean Processed Agmarknet Historical Data (Step 1 Output)

leakage_safety_rules_enforced: Lags strictly use prior trading sessions (t-1, t-3, t-7, t-14, t-30)
Rolling statistics strictly use historical observations up to t
Benchmark spatial features strictly use benchmark prices on or before date t
Target variables (t+1, t+3, t+7) are strictly forward-looking and separate from feature columns
Warmup window (30 observations) dropped to ensure 100% complete feature matrices without future back-filling

target_variables.target_price_t1: Next observed trading day modal price (t+1)
target_variables.target_return_t1: Percentage price return from t to t+1: (P_{t+1} - P_t) / P_t

lag_features.lag_1: Modal price at previous trading session (t-1)
lag_features.lag_3: Modal price at 3rd prior trading session (t-3)
lag_features.lag_7: Modal price at 7th prior trading session (t-7)
lag_features.lag_14: Modal price at 14th prior trading session (t-14)
lag_features.lag_30: Modal price at 30th prior trading session (t-30)
lag_features.days_since_last_trade: Calendar days elapsed between current session t and prior session t-1

temporal_cyclical_features.is_monday: Binary flag for Monday auction (weekend backlog)
temporal_cyclical_features.season_kharif: Binary flag for Kharif monsoon harvest (July-October)
temporal_cyclical_features.season_rabi: Binary flag for Rabi winter harvest (November-February)
temporal_cyclical_features.season_zaid: Binary flag for Zaid summer season (March-June)

spatial_benchmark_features.benchmark_price: Modal price at designated primary regional benchmark APMC at date t
spatial_benchmark_features.spread_vs_benchmark: Price differential: P_{market, t} - P_{benchmark, t}
